data.one_liner: Flexible picker widget for numbers, dates, arrays, and dependent columns in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable picker widgets including NumberPicker, DateTimePicker, ArrayPicker, and hierarchical linkage pickers. Supports modal, dialog, and embedded display modes with extensive localization and styling options.
use_when: You need to present a scroll wheel style picker for numbers, dates, or custom string options.
You require multi-column dependent or hierarchical selections.
You need built-in localization across multiple languages including RTL.
avoid_when: You are using standard Material date or time pickers and prefer platform-native UI dialogs.
Your application targets Flutter versions below 3.32.0.
strengths: Supports multiple picker types (Number, DateTime, Array, Linkage).
Highly customizable styling and layout options.
weaknesses: Some display methods and configuration options require imperative calls.
Requires a relatively recent minimum Flutter version (3.32.0).

alternatives.name: calendar_date_picker2
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you specifically need an advanced calendar grid date picker rather than a scroll wheel picker.

alternatives.name: flutter_colorpicker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you specifically need color selection pickers.
